theorems.name: Submission.dpf_unitOrientation_map_gramNormalized
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (ξ : MultiVector P n) (L : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P) (J : ℝ), IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q → Injective L → J = Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ Q) => inner ℝ (L (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ Q i)) (L (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ Q j)))) → 0 < J ∧ J ≤ ‖L‖ ^ n ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (J⁻¹ • ξ.comp (ContinuousAlternatingMap.compContinuousLinearMapCLM L)) (Submodule.map (L : Euclid P →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) Q)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
